outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of a questionnaire to classify PTD subtype based on birthing parent recall
cohort: 581 patients with PTD history documented in the LIFECODES study, a hospital-based birth cohort in Boston, Massachusetts
finding: A parental recall questionnaire demonstrated moderate-to-high sensitivity and specificity for classifying PTD subtypes (sPTL, pPROM, and ciPTD), even after a median of eight years postpartum.
